product.name: Personalized Sublingual Immunotherapy Treatment Plans
product.description: Personalized allergy treatment plans using sublingual (under-the-tongue) immunotherapy to desensitize patients to environmental allergens.

product.name: At-Home Allergy Testing Kit
product.description: A home-delivered allergy test kit that detects 40 common indoor and outdoor environmental allergens.

product.name: Virtual Allergy Doctor Consultations
product.description: Online consultations with board-certified allergists to assess allergy symptoms and develop treatment plans.

product.name: Ongoing Doctor Support and Care
product.description: Continuous access to board-certified doctors for treatment monitoring, questions, and adjustments via text, email, or calls.
